name: Revelica
description:
Revelica is a continuous product discovery engine that loops strategy, execution, and learning into a single system. This connector empowers Claude and coding agents to read and write directly to your team’s workspace, keeping strategic context, user research, product bets, and discovery experiments synchronized in one shared knowledge graph.

A Revelica workspace consolidates your technical discovery stack into a unified graph:
* Customer & Market Research: Interview snapshots with cited sources, segmented opportunities, competitive analyses, and scored market maps.
* Strategy & Frameworks: Unified product knowledge graph, RICE assessments, and unified product specs with story map, document, and markdown export/import views.
* Hypotheses & Execution: OKR-driven product bets, assumption finding, validation experiments, and MCP plugins for coding agents.

Every request is authenticated with OAuth and scoped to the user's own workspace and individual permission. Revelica does not read your chat history, conversation summaries, or files.

Built for product managers, product leaders, and the engineering teams collaborating with modern AI coding agents. Bring continuity to your discovery workflow. Get started for free at revelica.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Revelica to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Revelica to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.revelica.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Revelica MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revelica provides these MCP tools: create, list_skills, load_skill, query, read, and update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Revelica?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Revelica in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Revelica requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Revelica is developed by Revelica. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
